missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Темнота' is feminine nominative as the subject of 'наступила', which agrees in the feminine past tense. Describes nightfall.
Strategic focus: Genitive object. 'Темноты' is the feminine genitive form after 'боятся', which governs the genitive. A common childhood fear.

missions.phrase: Я ничего не вижу в темноте.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В темноте' uses the prepositional form 'темноте' after 'в' to express location. The negation 'ничего' adds emphasis.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Темноте' is the dative form after 'к', expressing what he got used to. A natural pattern with привыкнуть.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of content. 'Темнотой' is the instrumental form naming what the room was filled with. A vivid descriptive phrase.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Темноту' is the feminine accusative after 'в' showing motion into darkness. 'Полную' agrees in the feminine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of source. 'Темноты' is the genitive form after 'из', marking where the rustle came from. An atmospheric sentence.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Темнота' is the feminine nominative subject of 'скрыла', which agrees in the feminine. 'Его лицо' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Темноты' is the genitive form required after 'после'. The sentence contrasts darkness with returning light.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В темноте' uses the prepositional form 'темноте' after 'в'. The question asks why someone sits in the dark.
